notes.title: Update - bonus 11 fix, Linux support and more
notes.content:
Just sent out an update with a fix for the never ending Bonus Level 11. Also included in the update is Linux support, both 32 and 64 bit. We also added a separate build for Windows 32 bit systems.

As always, please let us know if you find anything not working the way it should! Thank you for your support :)
